basic_info.description: Experience cinematic eastern views from Grand Residence 31C, where soaring windows and high ceilings create an airy, light-filled ambiance. The sellers are the original owners of this property and the unit has been meticulously cared for. The open-concept kitchen, living, and dining areas offer panoramic outlooks of the Bay and Bay Bridge. Two very spacious bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms with ample closets and a large den which effortlessly functions as a third bedroom! Ample storage includes three walk-in closets and more storage throughout the home, along with three full spa-like bathrooms and a powder room.  Automated window treatments, laundry room and modern finishes completes the home. Enjoy urban luxury at it's finest with first-class amenities including ~20,000 sq. ft. of amenities including a Club Level featuring a wine cellar and tasting room, private dining room, fitness center, screening room, pool & spa, children's playroom, outdoor terrace with fire pits, and 24/7 lobby concierge. Don't miss this incredible opportunity to experience luxury at its finest! Ideally located in the heart of downtown, just moments from the Ferry Plaza's shops and cafes, iconic Embarcadero Waterfront, with convenient access to Highways 101 and 280.
